description.text: The set for Pokémon's 25th anniversary. From 9 February 2021 in the United States, each Happy Meal held a pack of four cards, the first time customers there got four cards with a Happy Meal. The 25 cards are Pikachu and the 24 first partner Pokémon of the eight regions so far, each in a standard and a confetti holo version, all with the Pokémon 25th logo. The promotion then went round the world through the year, Spain last in October 2021.
